'''Untos Poquot''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lost his [[Untos Poquot's wife|wife]] in [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. An excellent planner, he hated the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] with a passionate fury. The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Worrumba]] had a [[Life debt/Legends|life debt]] to Poquot. He led [[White Team (Mortex)|White Team]] during the [[Battle for Black Ice|capture]] of ''[[Black Ice/Legends|Black Ice]]'' and was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the assault.
